def thanos_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    left_half = arr[:n//2]
    right_half = arr[n//2:]
    left_sorted = thanos_sort(left_half)
    right_sorted = thanos_sort(right_half)
    merged = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < left_sorted and j < right_sorted:
        if left_half[i] <= right_half[j]:
            merged.append(left_half[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(right_half[j])
            j += 1
    merged.extend(left_half[i:])
    merged.extend(right_half[j:])
    return len(merged)

    def is_sorted(subarr):
        return all(subarr[i] <= subarr[i + 1] for i in range(len(subarr) - 1))

    max_length = 0

    def dfs(start, end):
        nonlocal max_length
        if start >= end:
            return 0
        mid = (start + end) // 2
        left_length = dfs(start, mid)
        right_length = dfs(mid + 1, end)
        if is_sorted(arr[start:mid + 1]):
            max_length = max(max_length, mid - start + 1)
        if is_sorted(arr[mid + 1:end + 1]):
            max_length = max(max_length, end - mid)

    dfs(0, n - 1)
    return max_length
